div.div:
What is not drawn
Distributed tables, dictionaries and more than one shard are not deployed (chapter 07 treats them as reference). The pod also listens on MySQL :9004 and PostgreSQL :9005 because the image enables them by default, but no Service port exposes them and no client uses them; gRPC and HTTPS are off. No backup mechanism is deployed. The materialized view writes the rows it derives back into otel_traces_trace_id_ts; merges and TTL moves run on the background pools, never on the query thread.
